actual_failure_evidence.interpretation: HTTPError establishes an unhandled HTTP response failure, not a particular401/403 or reason. PublicurllibGET is the indicated failure site by source and exception class; do not promote that localization inference to retained stack/status evidence.

control_reasoning: A single identical read whose sole purpose is to expose the lost numeric status addresses missing diagnostic evidence. The existing record does not establish an access refusal, so this is not a retry around a known401/403. It is materially narrower than rerunning the full preflight or obtaining successful object bytes. Actual denial, if observed, ends that effect retry immediately. Same carrier alone would not legalize retrying a known refusal.

admissible_diagnostic.carrier: Original functions.exec/tools.exec_command path under unchanged current toolgrants
admissible_diagnostic.transport: Same restored Python/urllib request behavior, defaultUserAgent, TLS verification, proxy/account context; no customization to gain access
admissible_diagnostic.purpose: Retain numeric HTTP status or transport-exception class and safe finalURL/same-origin metadata, timestamp and sourcebinding; classify only.
admissible_diagnostic.redirect_circumvention: Do not manually follow an alternate endpoint or change redirect/access behavior to obtain success. Record observed redirect/finalURL facts safely without replay.
admissible_diagnostic.output: One local diagnostic receipt; sanitize URL metadata if a response supplies credentials/query tokens; no raw headers/cookies/body.

outcome_rules.401_or_403: Explicit authentication/authorization denial for this access path: freeze it, preserve originalresponse status and carrier; do not changeURL/UserAgent/TLS/account/tool or launchworker to obtain body. Diagnose alreadyavailable configuration/evidence independently.
outcome_rules.other_explicit_denial: Preserve legal/policy denial or actual toolpermission rejection; no indirectretry.
outcome_rules.429: Rate-limit response: preserve capacityrestriction and no immediate retry; this diagnostic grants no repeatrequest or account/pathswitch.
outcome_rules.404_or_5xx_or_transport_error: Classify technical failure accurately. No automatic retryloop, fullpreflight replay or publication follows from this ruling; use result to choose bounded nextdiagnosis/repair.
outcome_rules.200_or_other_success: Close response without reading body. This establishes only status reachability, not authenticated/publicbody equality, freshpreflight success, or publisher admission.
outcome_rules.3xx: Record available redirect classification only; no alternateURL workaround.
outcome_rules.any_result: Return and consume actual terminal result. No second diagnostic under this ruling.

preserved_boundaries: Finite originalpublisher stillnotstarted; do not create scope or publish.
Absent/failed preflight receipt is not effectpermission.
Consumer/account evidence continues to age and mustmeet its actualbounds before any futurefiniteaction.
No invented403 or inventedgeneric humanpermissiongate from HTTPError alone.
If actualtoolreview rejects diagnostic, end that effect without alternatecarrier.
